description: Aivis Project is run by Walkers Inc. (株式会社Walkers), a Tokyo software company. It publishes the free AivisSpeech desktop app, the AivisHub voice-model sharing site and the Aivis Cloud API, a Japanese-only TTS API that serves community and official Style-Bert-VITS2 (AIVM) voice models, billed in JPY per character. All API servers run in Japan, and an API-compatible on-premises server (Citoras) is sold separately.
name: Aivis Cloud API
